game_title: Return Or Print – Frozen Gatehouse Race
game_concept: A strategy race set in Snowy Hold – Frozen Gatehouse, the frozen gate of the hold: the hold guard must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Or Print: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frozen Gatehouse: the frozen gate of the hold
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Gatehouse, repeat each round: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the hold guard ahead. Then check the court_score value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the frozen well by solving code steps involving court_score that move the hold guard forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the frozen well first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 2 (intro tier): Return Or Print
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Return Or Print' (Week 6 slot 15), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Frozen Gatehouse'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how court_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost imps in Frozen Gatehouse.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
